relationships.subject: Treg cells
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that endogenous Treg cells limit the persistence of headache-related sensitization and reduce the aversiveness of pain in response to repetitive stress.

relationships.subject: low-dose interleukin-2
relationships.evidence_quote: These results confirm that endogenous Treg cells mediate the therapeutic effects of LD-IL-2 after repetitive stress.

relationships.subject: TGF-beta
relationships.evidence_quote: indicating that the peripheral TGF-β signaling pathway facilitates the resolution of stress-induced sensitization

relationships.subject: kappa opioid receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: We conclude that peripheral KOR is activated by repetitive stress to suppress chronic sensitization.

key_findings: LD-IL-2 acts through Treg cells and IFN-gamma, IL-10 and TGF-beta, not opioid receptors, to eliminate stress-induced latent sensitization.
Tregs limit facial but not hindpaw stress-induced sensitization.
